SOUND / 250

Spatial audio

音の場所と距離を変える
HRTFによる定位と距離減衰を使い、合成音の位置を変えます。

見本の中を操作して変化を試してください。

ラボで詳しく試す ↗

ひとつ試すなら

ヘッドホンで左右と距離を変えてみてください。

こんなときに

効果音の設計、音色と空間の比較。

仕組みと使い方

ヘッドホンで左右と距離を変えてみてください。

lab=(function runAudioLab(root,cfg){
 const canvas=root.querySelector('canvas'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d'),button=root.querySelector('[data-audio]'),status=root.querySelector('.lab-status'),abort=new AbortController();let ac=null,osc=null,amp=null,filter=null,analyser=null,panner=null,delay=null,feedback=null,reverb=null,frame=0,timer=0,nodes=[],starting=false,dead=false,playing=false;
 const values=Object.fromEntries(cfg.controls.map(c=>[c.key,c.value]));canvas.width=640;canvas.height=360;

  if(data&&kind==='av-spectrum'){const a=new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);analyser.getByteFrequencyData(a);for(let i=0;i<32;i++){const h=a[i*3]/255*120;ctx.fillStyle=`rgb(${40+i*4},${40+i*4},${40+i*4})`;ctx.fillRect(5+i*9.8,135-h,6,h)}}
  else if(data&&(kind==='av-amplitude'||kind==='av-particles')){const rms=Math.sqrt(data.reduce((sum,x)=>sum+((x-128)/128)**2,0)/data.length);const r=15+rms*180;for(let i=0;i<(kind==='av-particles'?48:1);i++){const a=i*2.399,t=kind==='av-particles'?r+Math.sqrt(i)*5:0;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(160+Math.cos(a+ac.currentTime*.2)*t,75+Math.sin(a+ac.currentTime*.2)*t*.65,kind==='av-particles'?2+rms*8:r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}}
  else if(kind==='sound-spatial'){ctx.fillStyle='#bbb';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(160,100,16,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#333';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(160+(values.pan||0)*32,95-(values.distance||1)*15,9,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.font='11px Arial';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('listener',160,135);}
  else if(data){ctx.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<data.length;i++){const x=i/data.length*320,y=75+(data[i]-128)*.8;i?ctx.lineTo(x,y):ctx.moveTo(x,y)}ctx.stroke();}
  else {ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(15,75);ctx.lineTo(305,75);ctx.stroke();ctx.font='16px Arial';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('press to listen.',160,55);}
 }
 function stop(){playing=false;cancelAnimationFrame(frame);clearTimeout(timer);if(ac){const old=ac;ac=null;old.close().catch(()=>{});}nodes=[];button.textContent='音を再生';button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');status.textContent='停止中 · 音は自動では鳴りません';paint()}
 function update(){if(!ac)return;const now=ac.currentTime;osc.frequency.setTargetAtTime(values.pitch||220,now,.025);filter.frequency.setTargetAtTime(values.cutoff||2400,now,.025);filter.Q.setTargetAtTime(values.resonance||1,now,.025);if(panner){panner.positionX.setTargetAtTime(values.pan||0,now,.025);panner.positionZ.setTargetAtTime(-(values.distance||1),now,.025);}if(delay)delay.delayTime.setTargetAtTime(values.delay||.25,now,.025);if(feedback)feedback.gain.setTargetAtTime(values.feedback??.35,now,.025);if(cfg.kind==='sound-timbre')osc.type=['sine','triangle','square','sawtooth'][values.wave];}
 async function start(){if(starting||dead)return;if(playing){stop();return}starting=true;try{const Audio=globalThis.AudioContext||globalThis.webkitAudioContext;if(!Audio)throw Error('unavailable');ac=new Audio();await ac.resume();if(dead){ac.close();ac=null;return}osc=ac.createOscillator();osc.type=['sound-filter','av-spectrum'].includes(cfg.kind)?'sawtooth':'sine';amp=ac.createGain();amp.gain.value=.06;filter=ac.createBiquadFilter();filter.type='lowpass';analyser=ac.createAnalyser();analyser.fftSize=512;const master=ac.createGain();master.gain.value=.45;osc.connect(amp);amp.connect(filter);filter.connect(analyser);analyser.connect(master);master.connect(ac.destination);nodes=[osc,amp,filter,analyser,master];
  if(cfg.kind==='sound-delay'){delay=ac.createDelay(1);feedback=ac.createGain();feedback.gain.value=.3;filter.connect(delay);delay.connect(feedback);feedback.connect(delay);delay.connect(analyser);}
  if(cfg.kind==='sound-reverb'){reverb=ac.createConvolver();const length=Math.floor(ac.sampleRate*values.tail),impulse=ac.createBuffer(2,length,ac.sampleRate);let seed=42;for(let ch=0;ch<2;ch++){const a=impulse.getChannelData(ch);for(let i=0;i<length;i++){seed=(seed*1664525+1013904223)>>>0;a[i]=(seed/4294967296*2-1)*Math.pow(1-i/length,3);}}reverb.buffer=impulse;const wet=ac.createGain();wet.gain.value=.65;filter.connect(reverb);reverb.connect(wet);wet.connect(analyser);}
  if(cfg.kind==='sound-spatial'){panner=ac.createPanner();panner.panningModel='HRTF';panner.distanceModel='inverse';filter.disconnect();filter.connect(panner);panner.connect(analyser);}
  const now=ac.currentTime;update();osc.start(now);playing=true;button.textContent='音を停止';button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','true');status.textContent=cfg.kind==='sound-reverb'?'残響の長さは次回再生に反映 · 最大8秒':'再生中 · 最大8秒で自動停止';
  if(['sound-envelope','sound-reverb','sound-delay'].includes(cfg.kind)){amp.gain.cancelScheduledValues(now);amp.gain.setValueAtTime(0,now);amp.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.18,now+(values.attack||.02));amp.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,now+(values.attack||.02)+(values.release||.18));}
  const data=new Uint8Array(analyser.fftSize);function tick(){if(!playing||!ac||dead)return;if(cfg.kind==='av-amplitude'||cfg.kind==='av-particles')amp.gain.setTargetAtTime(.02+.12*Math.max(0,Math.sin(ac.currentTime*(values.tempo||90)/60*Math.PI*2)),ac.currentTime,.015);analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(data);paint(data);frame=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}tick();timer=setTimeout(stop,8000);

 button.addEventListener('click',start,{signal:abort.signal});for(const input of root.querySelectorAll('[data-key]'))input.addEventListener('input',()=>{values[input.dataset.key]=Number(input.value);input.closest('label').querySelector('output').textContent=input.value;update();if(!playing)paint()},{signal:abort.signal});document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)stop()},{signal:abort.signal});paint();
 return {setAuto(on){if(!on&&playing)stop()},destroy(){dead=true;stop();abort.abort()}};
